extracted.name: Easy Upside-Down Pizza Casserole
extracted.description: This upside-down pizza casserole might become your family’s new favorite meal; try this easy recipe with mushrooms, ground beef, and olives.
ingredient_lines: 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese, or more to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook and stir beef in the hot skillet until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain and discard grease.

Stir sauce, mushrooms, and olives into beef in the skillet. Cook and stir until heated through, about 2 minutes. Transfer mixture to a 2-quart rectangular baking dish. Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese.
Flatten each biscuit with your hands and arrange on top of cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven until biscuits are golden, 15 to 17 minutes.
